summary: Reviewed the cart completion and inventory reservation code. Two candidate weaknesses were submitted as attempts 1 and 2, based on code reading only; I have not received their run results, so neither is confirmed. Attempt 1: the default in-memory locking provider only serializes inside one process, which could let two servers oversell a shared item. Attempt 2: the per-line availability check in prepare-confirm-inventory-input.ts does not sum lines that share a WIDGET inventory item, though Medusa's reservation layer may still catch it. No claims are made until the results confirm a real failure.
